f.title: Semi-annual progress reports must include a summary of serious adverse events
f.statement: A progress report is delivered every six months to the regulatory authority by the principal investigator, recording partial results and progress; it must include the numbers of patients randomised, enrolled, active, withdrawn, completed, with clinical failure and still to enrol, and a summary of serious adverse events in the period.

rows.actor: Principal investigator (with the sponsor, CRO or SMO under article 82)
rows.quote: 4.78. Informe de avance. Informe entregado semestralmente a la autoridad reguladora por parte del investigador principal, donde se consignan los resultados parciales y el grado de avance de la investigación, debe incluir: número de pacientes aleatorizados, enrolados, activos, retirados, que completaron el estudio, que tuvieron falla clínica y que faltan por enrolar, resumen de eventos adversos serios en el período correspondiente.
rows.review_note: Review: content requirement stated in the definition ("debe incluir"); Mandatory. Re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: 4.78. Progress report. Report delivered every six months to the regulatory authority by the principal investigator, recording the partial results and degree of progress of the research; it must include: number of patients randomised, enrolled, active, withdrawn, who completed the study, who had clinical failure and still to be enrolled, and a summary of serious adverse events in the corresponding period.

f.title: Report serious breaches of the protocol within 7 calendar days of awareness
f.statement: Serious breaches of the authorised protocol must be communicated by the sponsor to the Department and the Research Ethics Committee without undue delay and at the latest within seven calendar days from the date it became aware of the breach.
f.clause: Capítulo V, 61. Comunicación de incumplimientos serios
f.processes: Clinical safety monitoring; Quality system & CAPA

rows.actor: Sponsor (patrocinador) of a clinical trial authorised in Guatemala
rows.deadline: Without undue delay and at the latest within 7 calendar days of awareness
rows.quote: Los incumplimientos serios del protocolo autorizado deben comunicarse por el patrocinador, sin demoras indebidas y a más tardar en el plazo de siete (7) días calendario a partir de la fecha en que haya tenido conocimiento del incumplimiento, a El Departamento y al Comité de Ética en Investigación.
rows.location: Capítulo V, 61. Comunicación de incumplimientos serios
rows.review_note: Review: quote verified verbatim; level follows the Spanish modal. Re-translation agrees with quote_en. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: Serious breaches of the authorised protocol must be communicated by the sponsor, without undue delay and at the latest within seven (7) calendar days from the date on which it became aware of the breach, to the Department and to the Research Ethics Committee.

deadline_rule.clock_start: fecha en que haya tenido conocimiento del incumplimiento
deadline_rule.applies_to: Serious breaches of the authorised protocol

f.title: Early termination report must include a summary of serious and non-serious adverse events
f.statement: On early termination, the sponsor must send the Department and the Research Ethics Committees a report with the data obtained up to termination: numbers screened, enrolled, withdrawn, completed and with clinical failure, a summary of serious and non-serious adverse events in the last period, the reasons for early termination and any measures taken for participants.
f.clause: Capítulo V, 63.3. Informe final del ensayo clínico por terminación anticipada

rows.actor: Sponsor (patrocinador) of a clinical trial authorised in Guatemala
rows.quote: 63.3. Informe final del ensayo clínico por terminación anticipada. Al contar con los datos disponibles, el patrocinador remitirá a El Departamento y a los Comités Éticos en Investigación implicados, un informe que incluya los datos obtenidos hasta el momento de su conclusión anticipada: número de pacientes tamizados, enrolados, retirados, que completaron el estudio, que tuvieron falla clínica y resumen de eventos adversos serios y no serios ocurridos en el último período, así como los motivos de la terminación anticipada, y en su caso las medidas adoptadas en relación con los sujetos participantes en el ensayo.
rows.location: Capítulo V, 63.3. Informe final del ensayo clínico por terminación anticipada
data_elements: serious and non-serious adverse events summary
rows.review_note: Review: quote verified verbatim; level follows the Spanish modal. Re-translation agrees with quote_en. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: 63.3. Final report of a clinical trial terminated early. Once the data are available, the sponsor shall send to the Department and the Research Ethics Committees involved a report including the data obtained up to early conclusion: number of patients screened, enrolled, withdrawn, who completed the study, who had clinical failure, and a summary of serious and non-serious adverse events in the last period, as well as the reasons for early termination and, where applicable, the measures adopted for the trial subjects.

f.title: Send semi-annual site progress reports to the Department
f.statement: The progress report of each trial site must be sent every six months by the investigator, sponsor, CRO or SMO to the Department, as set out in Annex 6.
f.clause: Capítulo IX, 82. Los informes de avance

rows.actor: Investigator, sponsor, contract research organisation or site management organisation
rows.quote: 82. Los informes de avance. El informe de avance de cada uno de los sitios o centros de Investigación que ejecutan el ensayo clínico será remitido semestralmente por el Investigador, Patrocinador, Organización de Investigación por Contrato u Organización de Manejo de Sitio a El Departamento, según se establece en el Anexo 6.
rows.location: Capítulo IX, 82. Los informes de avance
rows.review_note: Review: quote verified verbatim; level follows the Spanish modal. Re-translation agrees with quote_en. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: 82. Progress reports. The progress report of each research site conducting the clinical trial shall be sent every six months by the Investigator, Sponsor, Contract Research Organisation or Site Management Organisation to the Department, as established in Annex 6.

f.title: Communicate SUSARs to investigators and ethics committees and a summary to the Department
f.statement: Among its obligations, the sponsor must communicate suspected unexpected serious adverse reactions to the investigators and Research Ethics Committees involved in the trial, and a summary of them to the Department.

rows.actor: Sponsor (patrocinador) of a clinical trial authorised in Guatemala
rows.quote: 87.3.12. Comunicar a investigadores y Comités de Ética en Investigación, involucrados en el ensayo, las sospechas de reacciones adversas serias e inesperadas y a El Departamento un resumen de estas.
rows.review_note: Review: listed sponsor obligation; individual SUSAR reporting to the Department is also required by 118.1 and 118.8. Re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: 87.3.12. Communicate to the investigators and Research Ethics Committees involved in the trial the suspected serious and unexpected adverse reactions, and to the Department a summary of them.

f.title: Immediately provide any important information obtained during the trial
f.statement: The sponsor must provide immediately to the investigator, the institution, the Research Ethics Committee and the Department any important information it has access to during the trial.

rows.actor: Sponsor (patrocinador) of a clinical trial authorised in Guatemala
rows.quote: 87.3.13. Proporcionar al investigador, institución, Comité de Ética en Investigación y a El Departamento, de forma inmediata, cualquier información de importancia a la que tenga acceso durante el ensayo.
rows.review_note: Review: quote verified verbatim; level follows the Spanish modal. Re-translation agrees with quote_en. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: 87.3.13. Provide the investigator, institution, Research Ethics Committee and the Department, immediately, with any important information to which it has access during the trial.

f.title: Investigator: report serious adverse events within 24 hours to sponsor, ethics committee and Department
f.statement: The investigator must communicate all serious adverse events, except those identified in the protocol or investigator brochure as not requiring immediate reporting, within the first 24 hours of becoming aware, notifying the sponsor, the Research Ethics Committee and the Department by fax or e-mail.
f.clause: Capítulo XIV, 116. Obligaciones de los investigadores, 116.1
f.exceptions: Events identified in the protocol or investigator brochure as not requiring immediate reporting
f.processes: Clinical safety monitoring; Safety intake & collection

rows.actor: Investigator
rows.deadline: Within 24 hours of the investigator becoming aware
rows.quote: 116.1. Comunicar todos los eventos adversos serios, salvo cuando se trate de los señalados en el protocolo o en el folleto del investigador como eventos que no requieran comunicación inmediata, dentro de las primeras veinticuatro horas de conocimiento de este por el investigador, quien notificará al patrocinador, al Comité de Ética en Investigación y a El Departamento, por vía fax o correo electrónico.
rows.location: Capítulo XIV, 116. Obligaciones de los investigadores, 116.1
rows.review_note: Review: quote verified verbatim; level follows the Spanish modal. Re-translation agrees with quote_en. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: 116.1. Communicate all serious adverse events, except those indicated in the protocol or the investigator brochure as events not requiring immediate communication, within the first twenty-four hours of the investigator becoming aware of it, who shall notify the sponsor, the Research Ethics Committee and the Department by fax or e-mail.

deadline_rule.clock_start: conocimiento de este por el investigador
deadline_rule.applies_to: Serious adverse events in the trial (to sponsor, ethics committee and Department)

f.title: Investigator: send detailed written SAE reports to the ethics committee and the Department
f.statement: The investigator must communicate serious adverse events in writing and in detail to the Research Ethics Committee and the Department.

rows.actor: Investigator
rows.quote: 116.2. Comunicar por escrito y de forma pormenorizada, los eventos adversos serios al Comité de Ética en Investigación y a El Departamento.
rows.review_note: Review: quote verified verbatim; level follows the Spanish modal. Re-translation agrees with quote_en. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: 116.2. Communicate serious adverse events in writing and in detail to the Research Ethics Committee and the Department.

f.title: Investigator: identify trial subjects only by a specific code in safety communications
f.statement: In its communications the investigator must identify trial subjects by a specific code number for each of them.
f.processes: Clinical safety monitoring; Data integrity & records

rows.actor: Investigator
rows.quote: 116.3. Identificar a los sujetos del ensayo clínico mediante un número de código específico para cada uno de ellos, en las comunicaciones realizadas.
rows.review_note: Review: quote verified verbatim; level follows the Spanish modal. Re-translation agrees with quote_en. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: 116.3. Identify the clinical trial subjects by means of a specific code number for each of them in the communications made.

f.title: Investigator: report protocol-defined critical AEs and abnormal lab results to the sponsor
f.statement: The investigator must communicate to the sponsor the adverse events and abnormal laboratory results that the protocol identifies as critical to safety evaluations, according to the reporting requirements and within the periods specified in the protocol.

rows.actor: Investigator
rows.deadline: Within the periods specified in the protocol
rows.quote: 116.4. Comunicar al patrocinador los eventos adversos y los resultados de laboratorio anómalos calificados en el protocolo como determinantes para las evaluaciones de seguridad, con arreglo a los requisitos de comunicación y dentro de los períodos especificados en el protocolo.
rows.review_note: Review: quote verified verbatim; level follows the Spanish modal. Re-translation agrees with quote_en. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: 116.4. Communicate to the sponsor the adverse events and abnormal laboratory results classified in the protocol as decisive for safety evaluations, in accordance with the communication requirements and within the periods specified in the protocol.

f.title: Investigator: provide all additional information requested after a reported subject death
f.statement: Where the death of a trial subject has been reported, the investigator must provide the sponsor, the Department and the Research Ethics Committees involved with all additional information they request (116.7 repeats this for the sponsor and the committee).
f.processes: Clinical safety monitoring; Case processing & follow-up

rows.actor: Investigator
rows.quote: 116.5. Proporcionar al patrocinador, a El Departamento y a los Comités de Ética en Investigación implicados, toda la información complementaria que le soliciten, en caso de que se haya comunicado el fallecimiento de un sujeto participante en un ensayo clínico.
rows.review_note: Review: quote verified verbatim; level follows the Spanish modal. Re-translation agrees with quote_en. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: 116.5. Provide the sponsor, the Department and the Research Ethics Committees involved with all additional information they request, where the death of a subject participating in a clinical trial has been reported.

f.title: Investigator: report SAEs to the sponsor within 24 hours and send follow-up reports
f.statement: The investigator must communicate serious adverse events to the sponsor without undue delay and within 24 hours of becoming aware, unless the protocol states that certain SAEs do not require immediate reporting; where appropriate the investigator sends a follow-up report so the sponsor can assess impact on the trial benefit-risk balance. Subjects are identified only by their trial code in initial and follow-up reports.
f.processes: Clinical safety monitoring; Safety intake & collection

rows.actor: Investigator
rows.deadline: Without undue delay and within 24 hours of awareness
rows.quote: 116.6. El investigador comunicará al patrocinador los eventos adversos serios sin demoras indebidas y en un plazo de veinticuatro (24) horas a partir del momento en que tenga conocimiento de dichos eventos, salvo que, para determinados eventos adversos serios, el protocolo disponga que no se requiere una comunicación inmediata. El investigador, cuando proceda, enviará al patrocinador un informe de seguimiento para permitirle evaluar si el evento adverso serio tiene repercusiones en la relación beneficio-riesgo del ensayo clínico. En las comunicaciones iníciales y en las de seguimiento se identificará a los sujetos del ensayo clínico únicamente mediante el código de identificación del sujeto en el ensayo clínico, específico para cada uno de ellos.
rows.review_note: Review: quote verified verbatim; level follows the Spanish modal. Re-translation agrees with quote_en. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: 116.6. The investigator shall communicate serious adverse events to the sponsor without undue delay and within twenty-four (24) hours from the moment of becoming aware of them, unless, for certain serious adverse events, the protocol provides that immediate communication is not required. Where appropriate, the investigator shall send the sponsor a follow-up report to allow it to assess whether the serious adverse event has repercussions on the benefit-risk balance of the clinical trial. In initial and follow-up communications, trial subjects shall be identified only by the subject identification code in the clinical trial, specific to each of them.

deadline_rule.clock_start: momento en que tenga conocimiento de dichos eventos

f.title: Investigator: report post-trial related SAEs to the sponsor without undue delay
f.statement: If the investigator becomes aware of a serious adverse event with a suspected causal relationship to the investigational medicine occurring after the end of the trial in a subject they treated, they must report it to the sponsor without undue delay.
f.processes: Clinical safety monitoring; Safety intake & collection

rows.actor: Investigator
rows.quote: 116.8. Si el investigador tiene conocimiento de un evento adverso serio que guarde una supuesta relación causal con el medicamento en investigación, que se haya producido tras la finalización del ensayo clínico en un sujeto tratado por él, comunicará al patrocinador sin demora indebida dicho evento adverso serio.
rows.review_note: Review: quote verified verbatim; level follows the Spanish modal. Re-translation agrees with quote_en. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: 116.8. If the investigator becomes aware of a serious adverse event with a suspected causal relationship to the investigational medicine, occurring after the end of the clinical trial in a subject treated by them, they shall communicate that serious adverse event to the sponsor without undue delay.

f.title: Keep detailed records of all adverse events reported by investigators
f.statement: The sponsor must keep detailed records of all adverse events reported to it by investigators; these records are submitted to the Department on request.
f.processes: Clinical safety monitoring; Data integrity & records

rows.actor: Sponsor (patrocinador) of a clinical trial authorised in Guatemala
rows.quote: 117. Obligaciones del patrocinador. El Patrocinador deberá: 117.1. Mantener los registros detallados de todos los eventos adversos que le sean comunicados por los investigadores. Estos registros se presentarán a El Departamento cuando éste lo solicite.
rows.review_note: Review: quote verified verbatim; level follows the Spanish modal. Re-translation agrees with quote_en. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: 117. Obligations of the sponsor. The Sponsor shall: 117.1. Keep detailed records of all adverse events communicated to it by the investigators. These records shall be submitted to the Department when it so requests.

f.title: Continuously evaluate the trial benefit-risk balance and investigational product safety
f.statement: The sponsor must continuously evaluate the balance between the benefits and risks of the clinical trial, including continuous evaluation of the safety of the investigational medicines using all information available.
f.processes: Clinical safety monitoring; Benefit–risk review; Signal management

rows.actor: Sponsor (patrocinador) of a clinical trial authorised in Guatemala
rows.quote: 117.2. Evaluar de forma continua el balance entre los beneficios y los riesgos del ensayo clínico, lo que incluye una evaluación continua de la seguridad de los medicamentos en investigación utilizando toda la información a su alcance.
rows.review_note: Review: quote verified verbatim; level follows the Spanish modal. Re-translation agrees with quote_en. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: 117.2. Continuously evaluate the balance between the benefits and risks of the clinical trial, which includes a continuous evaluation of the safety of the investigational medicines using all the information within its reach.

f.title: Report important safety information to the Department, authorities and ethics committees within 15 calendar days
f.statement: The sponsor must communicate immediately to the Department, the competent bodies and the Research Ethics Committees involved, without undue delay and within 15 calendar days, any important information affecting the safety of the investigational medicine, except suspected unexpected serious adverse reactions, which are reported under item 118.
f.exceptions: SUSARs, which are reported under article 118

rows.actor: Sponsor (patrocinador) of a clinical trial authorised in Guatemala
rows.deadline: Immediately, without undue delay, within 15 calendar days
rows.quote: 117.3. Comunicar inmediatamente a El Departamento, a los órganos competentes y a los Comités de Ética en Investigación implicados, sin demoras indebidas, en el plazo de quince (15) días calendario, cualquier información importante que afecte la seguridad del medicamento en investigación, con excepción de las sospechas de reacciones adversas serios e inesperadas que se comunicarán conforme al inciso 118.
rows.review_note: Review: the sentence states no clock start for the 15 calendar days, so no deadline_rule. Re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: 117.3. Communicate immediately to the Department, the competent bodies and the Research Ethics Committees involved, without undue delays, within fifteen (15) calendar days, any important information affecting the safety of the investigational medicine, except suspected serious and unexpected adverse reactions, which shall be communicated in accordance with item 118.

f.title: Rapidly inform investigators of information that may adversely affect subject safety
f.statement: The sponsor must rapidly communicate to investigators any important information that could adversely affect the safety of subjects or the conduct of the clinical trial.

rows.actor: Sponsor (patrocinador) of a clinical trial authorised in Guatemala
rows.quote: 117.4. El patrocinador deberá comunicar rápidamente a los investigadores cualquier información importante que pudiera afectar negativamente a la seguridad de los sujetos o a la realización del ensayo clínico.
rows.review_note: Review: quote verified verbatim; level follows the Spanish modal. Re-translation agrees with quote_en. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: 117.4. The sponsor shall rapidly communicate to the investigators any important information that could adversely affect the safety of the subjects or the conduct of the clinical trial.

f.title: Report all SUSARs for investigational medicines not marketed in Guatemala, domestic and foreign
f.statement: The sponsor must notify the investigator, the institution concerned, the Research Ethics Committees and the Department of all suspected serious and unexpected adverse reactions (SUSAR, CIOMS) associated with the investigational medicines of which it becomes aware, whether occurring in Guatemala or other countries, and whether in the authorised trial, other trials or another context of use, provided those medicines are not marketed in the country.
f.clause: Capítulo XIV, 118. Directrices para la notificación de casos de sospecha de reacción adversa, 118.1
f.applicability: Investigational medicines not marketed in Guatemala
f.exceptions: Suspected adverse reactions attributable to placebo are not subject to this individual reporting system (118.6); marketed products follow the National Pharmacovigilance Programme rules (118.2)
f.processes: Clinical safety monitoring; Submission operations; Reporting policy

rows.actor: Sponsor (patrocinador) of a clinical trial authorised in Guatemala
rows.quote: 118.1. El patrocinador notificará al investigador, a la institución interesada, a los Comités de Ética en Investigación y a El Departamento todas las Sospechas de Reacciones Adversas Serias (SUSAR, CIOMS) y a la vez inesperadas, asociadas a los medicamentos en investigación de las que haya tenido conocimiento, tanto si ocurren en el país como en otros países, y tanto si han ocurrido en el ensayo clínico autorizado como en otros ensayos clínicos o en un contexto de uso diferente, siempre que dichos medicamentos no se encuentren comercializados en el país.
rows.location: Capítulo XIV, 118. Directrices para la notificación de casos de sospecha de reacción adversa, 118.1
rows.review_note: Review: quote verified verbatim; level follows the Spanish modal. Re-translation agrees with quote_en. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: 118.1. The sponsor shall notify the investigator, the institution concerned, the Research Ethics Committees and the Department of all Suspected Serious and at the same time unexpected Adverse Reactions (SUSAR, CIOMS) associated with the investigational medicines of which it has become aware, whether they occur in the country or in other countries, and whether in the authorised clinical trial or in other clinical trials or in a different context of use, provided those medicines are not marketed in the country.

f.title: Report ADRs to marketed comparators and concomitant medicines under the national PV rules
f.statement: For products marketed in Guatemala, including the control medicine and concomitant medicines, adverse reaction reporting follows the corresponding regulation of the National Pharmacovigilance Programme.

rows.actor: Sponsor (patrocinador) of a clinical trial authorised in Guatemala
rows.quote: 118.2. Para los productos comercializados, incluyendo el medicamento utilizado como control o los medicamentos utilizados como concomitantes, se realizará según la Normativa correspondiente del Programa Nacional de Farmacovigilancia.
rows.review_note: Review: quote verified verbatim; level follows the Spanish modal. Re-translation agrees with quote_en. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: 118.2. For marketed products, including the medicine used as control or medicines used as concomitants, [notification] shall be made according to the corresponding Regulation of the National Pharmacovigilance Programme.

f.title: Report SUSARs within 7 calendar days of sponsor awareness
f.statement: The maximum time limit for notifying a SUSAR is seven calendar days from the moment the sponsor became aware of the suspected adverse reaction.

rows.actor: Sponsor (patrocinador) of a clinical trial authorised in Guatemala
rows.deadline: Within 7 calendar days of sponsor awareness
rows.quote: 118.3. El plazo máximo de notificación será de siete (7) días calendario a partir del momento en que el patrocinador haya tenido conocimiento de la sospecha de reacción adversa.
rows.review_note: Review: quote verified verbatim; level follows the Spanish modal. Re-translation agrees with quote_en. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: 118.3. The maximum notification period shall be seven (7) calendar days from the moment the sponsor became aware of the suspected adverse reaction.

deadline_rule.clock_start: momento en que el patrocinador haya tenido conocimiento de la sospecha de reacción adversa
deadline_rule.applies_to: SUSARs (investigational medicines not marketed in Guatemala)

f.title: Report fatal or life-threatening SUSARs to the Department within 48 hours
f.statement: When the suspected serious unexpected adverse reaction caused the death of the subject or endangered their life, the sponsor must inform the Department within 48 hours from the moment it became aware of the case.

rows.actor: Sponsor (patrocinador) of a clinical trial authorised in Guatemala
rows.quote: Cuando la sospecha de reacción adversa seria e inesperada haya ocasionado la muerte del sujeto, o puesto en peligro su vida, el patrocinador informará a El Departamento en el plazo de cuarenta y ocho (48) horas a partir del momento en que el patrocinador tenga conocimiento del caso.
rows.review_note: Review: quote verified verbatim; level follows the Spanish modal. Re-translation agrees with quote_en. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: When the suspected serious and unexpected adverse reaction has caused the death of the subject or endangered their life, the sponsor shall inform the Department within forty-eight (48) hours from the moment the sponsor becomes aware of the case.

deadline_rule.clock_start: momento en que el patrocinador tenga conocimiento del caso
deadline_rule.applies_to: Fatal or life-threatening SUSARs (to the Department)

f.title: Complete fatal or life-threatening SUSAR information within the following 7 days
f.statement: The information on a fatal or life-threatening SUSAR must be completed, as far as possible, within the following seven days.
f.processes: Clinical safety monitoring; Case processing & follow-up

rows.actor: Sponsor (patrocinador) of a clinical trial authorised in Guatemala
rows.quote: Dicha información deberá ser completada, en lo posible, en los siete (7) días siguientes.
rows.review_note: Review: "en lo posible" qualifies the duty; the clock start of the 7 days (after the 48-hour report) is implicit, so no deadline_rule. Re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: Such information shall be completed, as far as possible, within the following seven (7) days.

f.title: Report non-fatal, non-life-threatening SUSARs within 7 days of sponsor awareness
f.statement: For suspected serious unexpected adverse reactions that are not fatal and not life-threatening, notification is due at the latest seven days after the sponsor became aware of the reaction.

rows.actor: Sponsor (patrocinador) of a clinical trial authorised in Guatemala
rows.deadline: At the latest 7 days after sponsor awareness
rows.quote: 118.4. En caso de sospechas de reacciones adversas serias e inesperadas no mortales o que no pongan en peligro la vida, a más tardar siete (7) días después de que el patrocinador haya tenido conocimiento de la reacción.
rows.review_note: Review: 118.4 does not say calendar days; 118.3 sets the general 7 calendar-day maximum, so calendar_days is used. The verb is implied from 118.3/118.1. Re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: 118.4. In the case of suspected serious and unexpected adverse reactions that are not fatal or not life-threatening, at the latest seven (7) days after the sponsor has become aware of the reaction.

deadline_rule.clock_start: después de que el patrocinador haya tenido conocimiento de la reacción

f.title: Unblind individual SUSAR cases only when needed for managing the reaction; define the procedure in the protocol
f.statement: For serious unexpected adverse reactions detected in double-blind trials, the blind must be broken only where the information is necessary to decide how to manage the reaction. The procedure for unblinding individual patients must be specified in the study protocol.

rows.actor: Sponsor (patrocinador) of a clinical trial authorised in Guatemala
rows.quote: 118.5. En casos de reacciones adversas serias e inesperadas detectadas en el desarrollo de ensayos clínicos doble ciego, el código de tratamiento doble ciego deberá ser abierto únicamente en aquellos casos en que la información a obtener sea necesaria para determinar la conducta a seguir en el manejo de la reacción adversa. El procedimiento para abrir el código de tratamiento doble ciego de pacientes individuales debe estar especificado en el protocolo de estudio.
rows.review_note: Review: quote verified verbatim; level follows the Spanish modal. Re-translation agrees with quote_en. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: 118.5. In cases of serious and unexpected adverse reactions detected in double-blind clinical trials, the double-blind treatment code shall be broken only in those cases where the information to be obtained is necessary to determine the course of action in managing the adverse reaction. The procedure for breaking the double-blind treatment code of individual patients must be specified in the study protocol.

f.title: Placebo-attributable suspected reactions are not subject to individual SUSAR notification
f.statement: Suspected adverse reactions attributable to placebo are not subject to the individual notification system.

rows.actor: Sponsor (patrocinador) of a clinical trial authorised in Guatemala
rows.quote: 118.6. Las sospechas de reacciones adversas atribuibles a placebo no estarán sujetas a este sistema de notificación individualizada.
rows.review_note: Review: an exemption from individual reporting, recorded as Permitted. Re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: 118.6. Suspected adverse reactions attributable to placebo shall not be subject to this individual notification system.

f.title: Use the national form or CIOMS, in English with a Spanish summary (Guatemalan cases in Spanish); send SUSARs to all sites
f.statement: Suspected adverse reaction notifications occurring inside and outside Guatemala must use the corresponding form or CIOMS, in English with a summary in Spanish, except Guatemalan cases, which must be in Spanish. The sponsor must send SUSAR (CIOMS) reports to all participating sites from site initiation for their information and processing.

rows.actor: Sponsor (patrocinador) of a clinical trial authorised in Guatemala
rows.quote: 118.7. Las notificaciones de sospechas de reacciones adversas que ocurran fuera y dentro de Guatemala se realizarán utilizando el formato correspondiente o en el CIOMS, y tendrán que ser comunicadas en idioma inglés y un resumen en español, excepto las de Guatemala que deberán ser en idioma español. Los reportes de Reacciones Adversas Serias (SUSARS –CIOMS) deberán ser enviadas por parte del patrocinador a todos los sitios participantes a partir de la iniciación del sitio o centro de Investigación, para conocimiento de este y su apropiado procesamiento.
rows.review_note: Review: quote verified verbatim; level follows the Spanish modal. Re-translation agrees with quote_en. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: 118.7. Notifications of suspected adverse reactions occurring outside and inside Guatemala shall be made using the corresponding format or CIOMS, and must be communicated in English with a summary in Spanish, except those from Guatemala, which shall be in Spanish. Serious Adverse Reaction reports (SUSARs - CIOMS) shall be sent by the sponsor to all participating sites from the initiation of the research site, for its information and appropriate processing.

f.title: Report SUSARs individually to ethics committees and the Department within 7 calendar days
f.statement: The sponsor must notify the Research Ethics Committees involved and the Department, individually and within a maximum of seven calendar days, of all suspected adverse reactions that are both serious and unexpected and associated with the investigational medicine.

rows.actor: Sponsor (patrocinador) of a clinical trial authorised in Guatemala
rows.quote: 118.8. El patrocinador notificará a los Comités de Ética en Investigación implicados y a El Departamento, de forma individual y en el plazo máximo de siete (7) días calendario, todas las sospechas de reacciones adversas que sean a la vez serias e inesperadas asociadas al medicamento en investigación.
rows.review_note: Review: no clock start in this sentence; clock_start taken from 118.3 (sponsor awareness). Re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: 118.8. The sponsor shall notify the Research Ethics Committees involved and the Department, individually and within a maximum of seven (7) calendar days, of all suspected adverse reactions that are both serious and unexpected associated with the investigational medicine.

deadline_rule.clock_start: momento en que el patrocinador haya tenido conocimiento de la sospecha de reacción adversa
deadline_rule.applies_to: SUSARs (to ethics committees and the Department)

f.title: Report fatal or life-threatening SUSARs to ethics committees and the Department within 48 hours
f.statement: The maximum time limit is 48 hours for suspected adverse reactions that cause death or are life-threatening.

rows.actor: Sponsor (patrocinador) of a clinical trial authorised in Guatemala
rows.quote: El plazo máximo será de cuarenta y ocho (48) horas cuando se trate de sospechas de reacciones adversas que produzcan la muerte o amenacen la vida.
rows.review_note: Review: no clock start in this sentence; clock_start taken from 118.3 (sponsor awareness of the case). Re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: The maximum period shall be forty-eight (48) hours in the case of suspected adverse reactions that cause death or threaten life.

deadline_rule.clock_start: momento en que el patrocinador tenga conocimiento del caso
deadline_rule.applies_to: Fatal or life-threatening SUSARs (to ethics committees and the Department)

f.title: Report other SUSAR information when ethics committees require it or the safety profile changes importantly
f.statement: The sponsor must notify any other information on serious unexpected adverse reactions associated with the investigational medicine when the Research Ethics Committees involved so provide at the favourable opinion on the trial and, in any case, if the information represents an important change in the safety profile of the investigational product.

rows.actor: Sponsor (patrocinador) of a clinical trial authorised in Guatemala
rows.quote: 118.9. El patrocinador notificará cualquier otra información sobre reacciones adversas serias e inesperadas, asociadas al medicamento de investigación cuando así lo dispongan los Comités de Ética en Investigación implicados en el momento del dictamen favorable del ensayo clínico y, en cualquier caso, si la información supone un cambio importante en el perfil de seguridad del producto investigado.
rows.review_note: Review: quote verified verbatim; level follows the Spanish modal. Re-translation agrees with quote_en. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: 118.9. The sponsor shall notify any other information on serious and unexpected adverse reactions associated with the investigational medicine when the Research Ethics Committees involved so provide at the time of the favourable opinion on the clinical trial and, in any case, if the information represents an important change in the safety profile of the investigational product.

f.title: Submit an annual safety report on the investigational medicine until the end of the trial
f.statement: The periodic safety report must be submitted to the Department, the competent authorities and the Research Ethics Committees involved annually until the end of the trial and whenever the Ministry of Public Health authorities or the committees request it.
f.clause: Capítulo XIV, 119. Informes periódicos de seguridad

rows.actor: Sponsor (patrocinador) of a clinical trial authorised in Guatemala
rows.deadline: Annually until the end of the trial, and on request
rows.quote: El informe periódico de seguridad se presentará a El Departamento, autoridades competentes y a los Comités de Ética en Investigación implicados, anualmente hasta el final del ensayo clínico y siempre que lo soliciten las autoridades del Ministerio de Salud Pública y Asistencia Social o los Comités de Ética en Investigación implicados.
rows.location: Capítulo XIV, 119. Informes periódicos de seguridad
rows.review_note: Review: quote verified verbatim; level follows the Spanish modal. Re-translation agrees with quote_en. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: The periodic safety report shall be submitted to the Department, competent authorities and the Research Ethics Committees involved annually until the end of the clinical trial and whenever requested by the authorities of the Ministry of Public Health and Social Assistance or the Research Ethics Committees involved.

f.title: Prepare an ad hoc evaluation report without delay when a relevant safety problem arises
f.statement: Regardless of the periodic schedule, the sponsor must prepare an evaluation report whenever there is a relevant safety problem and submit it without delay to the Department, the competent authorities and the Research Ethics Committees concerned.
f.clause: Capítulo XIV, 119. Informes periódicos de seguridad

rows.actor: Sponsor (patrocinador) of a clinical trial authorised in Guatemala
rows.quote: Sin perjuicio de la periodicidad señalada para los informes de seguridad, el patrocinador preparará un informe de evaluación siempre que exista un problema de seguridad relevante. Dicho informe se presentará sin tardanza a El Departamento, las autoridades competentes y a los Comités de Ética en Investigación correspondientes.
rows.location: Capítulo XIV, 119. Informes periódicos de seguridad
rows.review_note: Review: quote verified verbatim; level follows the Spanish modal. Re-translation agrees with quote_en. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: Without prejudice to the periodicity indicated for safety reports, the sponsor shall prepare an evaluation report whenever there is a relevant safety problem. That report shall be submitted without delay to the Department, the competent authorities and the corresponding Research Ethics Committees.

f.title: Simplified safety report permitted for authorised products used within their marketing authorisation
f.statement: Sponsors of trials in which the investigational medicines (excluding placebos) are authorised and used per the protocol within the terms of the marketing authorisation may submit a simplified safety report on those medicines.
f.clause: Capítulo XIV, 119. Informes periódicos de seguridad

rows.actor: Sponsor (patrocinador) of a clinical trial authorised in Guatemala
rows.quote: Los patrocinadores de ensayos clínicos en los que los medicamentos en investigación, excluidos los placebos, estén autorizados y, según el protocolo del ensayo clínico, se utilicen de conformidad con los términos de la autorización de comercialización, podrán presentar un informe simplificado de la seguridad de dichos medicamentos.
rows.location: Capítulo XIV, 119. Informes periódicos de seguridad
rows.review_note: Review: quote verified verbatim; level follows the Spanish modal. Re-translation agrees with quote_en. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: Sponsors of clinical trials in which the investigational medicines, excluding placebos, are authorised and, according to the clinical trial protocol, are used in accordance with the terms of the marketing authorisation, may submit a simplified safety report on those medicines.

f.title: Failure to report adverse events, or late reporting, is an infraction
f.statement: Infractions under this Regulation include failure by those responsible for the safety surveillance of the investigational product to communicate its adverse events to the Department, and communicating detected adverse events to the Department after the deadline established in this Regulation.
f.legal_basis: Decreto 90-97, Código de Salud (art. 153 of the Normativa)
f.processes: Clinical safety monitoring; Quality system & CAPA
